nodes.label: Real AE L2 and centered HP0
nodes.meaning: Real Hilbert equivalence classes; inverse/perturbations stay on the same centered macro space.

nodes.label: PBPS analytic hypothesis background
nodes.meaning: Same C2 potential,alpha>0,alpha<=beta,both Hessian bounds,eta>0,beta eta<=1; six existing analytic callers retained.

nodes.label: Actual P, residual, macro/micro domains
nodes.meaning: P=conditional expectation given Y,R=Pperp; micro is all kerP, not ranV.

nodes.label: Same actual reflection U
nodes.meaning: AE pullback by(x,2x-y),self-adjoint/unitary,not arbitrary coefficient operator.

nodes.label: Same centered compression A
nodes.meaning: Restriction/transport of PUP to the same HP0,real self-adjoint.

nodes.label: Same positive root Gamma and centered inverse J
nodes.meaning: Gamma=(I-A²)^1/2; bounded two-sided inverse on HP0 only; no inverse across constants.

nodes.label: Self-adjointness, commutation and squaresum
nodes.meaning: A,Gamma,J self-adjoint; A commutes withGamma andJ; A²+Gamma²=I; inverse SA/commutation are internal functional-calculus/inverse consequences.

nodes.label: Same polar isometric embedding V
nodes.meaning: V:HP0->allkerP isometric,not onto; adjoint maps microscopic vectors into HP0.

nodes.label: Actual centered f and actual ideal g components
nodes.meaning: f globally centered; g=U(Pf-(f-Pf)),gP=Pg,gV=V*Rg; mean_g internal reflection-law/conditional-integral completion.

nodes.label: Exact B20 corrector
nodes.meaning: C(u,v)=(||u||²-||v||²)/2-inner(A(Ju),v); same A/J and same HP0.

nodes.label: Arbitrary centered perturbation pair
nodes.meaning: For u,v,r in the same real H,form u+Gamma r and v-A r; r here is an arbitrary perturbation vector,not source residual r orrrho.

nodes.label: Full norm/cross expansion
nodes.meaning: Expand B20 at the perturbed pair,using JGamma=I.

nodes.label: Cancellation of v terms
nodes.meaning: Real inner symmetry cancels +inner(v,Ar)-inner(Ar,v).

nodes.label: Linear terms become inner(u,Jr)
nodes.meaning: A/Gamma/J self-adjoint commutation and squaresum give Gamma+J A²=J.

nodes.label: Quadratic terms become norm(r)^2/2
nodes.meaning: ||Gamma r||²+||Ar||²=||r||²,with exact positive half.

nodes.label: Generic Hilbert perturbation leaf
nodes.meaning: C(u+Gamma r,v-A r)-C(u,v)=inner(u,Jr)+||r||²/2; independent of B21.

nodes.label: Actual PBPS original-input specialization
nodes.meaning: Specialize generic identity to already produced actual gP,gV and same root/inverse. If still forallr:HP0,this is a bounded perturbation consumer,not actualK orrrho construction.

nodes.label: Actual half-turn H and Markov K difference
nodes.meaning: H is source conditional half-turn/Markov operator; K=U[P+(1-rho)Hmicro]. Need actual semantics,not arbitrary H.

nodes.label: Actual residual rrho and centeredness
nodes.meaning: rrho=V*[I+(1-rho)Hmicro]fperp=rho fV+(1-rho)r_source; r_source=V*(I+Hmicro)fperp; both centered by codomain.

nodes.label: B27 actual output components
nodes.meaning: (Kf)P=gP+Gamma rrho,(Kf)V=gV-A rrho via same polar and all-micro intertwining.

nodes.label: Actual ideal B21 change
nodes.meaning: C(gP,gV)-C(fP,fV)=-||fP||²+||fV||²; inherited actual edge,not parent of S15.

nodes.label: B28 combined real consumer
nodes.meaning: Combine actual B27/S15 at rrho with actual B21; adds inner(gP,Jrrho)+||rrho||²/2.

nodes.label: Residual norm/Young bounds
nodes.meaning: B29/B30/B31 use separate B17 error,centered gap and rho/constant bounds; outside prospective perturbation header.

nodes.label: Full B4 Lyapunov decay/main boundary
nodes.meaning: FullB4 needs ordinary norm decay,norm equivalence,smallc0,omega/rho/Lambda estimates; no whole-paper/main/errors/cost/Goal credit.
